homepage.body:
Text +1 (989) 300-0998
Support Center

Preventing Fraud at The Source

Our all-in-one platform enhanced by Mozo’s AI protection keeps scams, fraud, and cyber threats at bay.
As Seen In

Scams Are Rising. Losses Are Real.

In 2024, $12.5 billion vanished into the hands of scammers (FTC Press Release).
Halfway through 2025, over $3 billion is already gone (Newsweek, July 2025).

A safer, much happier digital world.
Powered by AI.

Identity
Your identity is priceless - keep it safe from scammers and cybercriminals. Our AI-driven defense stops identity theft and fraud before it’s too late.
Security
Stay ahead of cyber threats with the same level of security that Fortune 500 companies use. From malware to phishing, we’ve got you covered.
Privacy
Your online privacy shouldn’t be a guessing game. We protect your data from trackers and snoopers, so you stay private where it matters most.

Protect what matters most with the
Online Security Platform.

Your identity belongs to you
Get alerted and take action if sensitive information like your address or Social Security number gets traded over the dark web.
Scam-proof your digital life
Guard against deceptive schemes that can harm the lives of the ones you love.
Lock down your data
Safeguard your personal and financial information during the fallout of a data breach.
AI-powered protection
Old antivirus no longer cuts it. Get EDR security and know you’re protected from malware, even if you’re patient zero
Top privacy, fast connection
Stop hackers from snooping on your activity. Get enhanced privacy and watch the content you want - wherever you are.
Don’t fall for the bait
Prevent scammers from tricking you into revealing sensitive information. Ensure your online interactions remain secure and your money stays in your pocket.
Surf the web with confidence
Keep viruses at bay and stop malicious sites from infecting your devices.
Let kids be kids
Allow your kids to grow up in a safe digital environment free from adult content, cyberbullying, and online predators.
Browse clean, stay secure
Block pesky and malicious ads so you can connect online distraction-free.

How safe are you online?

Partnering with industry leaders.

4.5 Rating on Google Chrome
Virus Bulletin VB100 Certified
Microrosft Virus Initiative (MVI) Member
OPSWAT Anti-Malware Certified
5.0 Rating on Microsoft Edge
Learn More

Carmella Lopez
“This extension really hooked me with its ability to prevent 3 phishing attacks in the last month!”
Liam Roberts
“Online Security is awesome! Like a personal bodyguard for my online adventures ;) ”

“I was hit with an irritating browser hijacker, but this extension straightened it all out. Thank you.”
Eddie Torres

Complete security for your device,
privacy, and identity.
